Activities

Activities planned from Afghanistan’s travel hubs

Eight activity classes — hiking, fishing, trekking, skiing, shopping, sightseeing, horse riding, and cycling — linked to operational hubs. Availability depends on season, access, and local arrangements. No invented venues or prices.

Specialist expedition support (for example ski expeditions or Noshaq) stays under Specialist Services — not moved into this catalog.

8 hubs

Hiking

Guided hiking from operational hubs — valleys, viewpoints, and highland paths planned around current access.
